name: Granite Boulder, Large
description: Large rounded granite field/stream boulder with mossy top — stacked bevelBox cluster approximates spheroidal-weathering profile; graniteMoss crown + shoulder patches; charBlack crack detail on right face.

parts.name: Base slab — widest bottom layer (spheroidal-weathering base spread)
parts.note: 1100×200×900 mm; centre at y=0.10 so bottom touches y=0 (floor). Widest layer — tapers above.

parts.name: Mid body — main mass, slightly narrower
parts.note: 960×320×780 mm; stacked on base_slab (bottom at y=0.20).

parts.name: Upper shoulder — narrowed dome section
parts.note: 740×200×600 mm; centre y=0.58 (bottom y=0.48, within mid_bulk — natural overlap for rounded profile).

parts.name: Top granite cap — smallest, rounded apex
parts.note: 480×120×400 mm; sits exactly on upper_dome top (y=0.68 + 0.06 = top at 0.80).

parts.name: Moss mat — crown of boulder (thickest accumulation, most sheltered)
parts.note: 360×60×280 mm; sits on top_cap top (y=0.80); centre y=0.83, top y=0.86.

parts.name: Moss patch — left rear shoulder
parts.note: 220×40×180 mm; upper_dome left shoulder (top at y=0.69, 10 mm above upper_dome top y=0.68 — no coplanar face). Slightly forward-right of centre for asymmetry.

parts.name: Moss patch — right rear shoulder
parts.note: 180×40×160 mm; +X face at x=0.35 (2 cm inboard of upper_dome +X face at x=0.37 — avoids coplanar z-fight). Top at y=0.69.

parts.name: Front protrusion — un-exfoliated rock ear, irregular forward face
parts.note: 440×260×180 mm; offset right (+x 0.09) for asymmetry. Centre z=0.48, front face at z=0.57 (extends beyond base_slab front z=0.45).

parts.name: Left side lobe — irregular mass protrusion
parts.note: 140×220×320 mm; extends beyond base_slab left face (lobe -X at x=-0.58 vs base_slab -X at x=-0.55).

parts.name: Vertical thermal crack — charBlack fissure, right face mid-body
parts.note: 60×280×60 mm; straddles mid_bulk +X face (crack +X at x=0.49, mid_bulk +X at x=0.48 — 10 mm proud, visible). Top y=0.51 (≠ mid_bulk top y=0.52), bottom y=0.23 (≠ mid_bulk bottom y=0.20) — no coplanar y-faces.
